Prince Jackson (29) and Bigi "Blanket" Jackson (24) made a rare red carpet appearance together at the world premiere of the biopic Michael in Berlin on April 10, 2026. The brothers supported their cousin, Jaafar Jackson, who plays Michael, wearing suits that paid homage to their father's iconic style. Key Details of the Premiere Appearance: Location: The Michael movie premiere took place at the Uber Eats Music Hall in Berlin, Germany. Outfits: Prince wore a black suit with a red shirt, mirroring Michael’s 2002 "Dangerous" performance look, while Bigi wore a black suit with a gold-striped jacket and an armband honoring his father. Family Support: The brothers were joined by uncles Marlon and Jackie Jackson to support cousin Jaafar Jackson, who stars in the film. Notable Absences: Paris Jackson was not in attendance, having previously expressed criticism of the film and stating she had zero involvement. Janet Jackson was also absent. Release Date: The Michael biopic is set to hit theaters on April 24, 2026.
